calls.title: Growthbook <> Yeet - Proposal Review
calls.summary: The team reviewed the possibility of upgrading from a Pro to an Enterprise plan, highlighting the benefits of enhanced service level agreements (SLA) and support. The Enterprise option includes a global support team, direct access to engineers, and comprehensive training for new staff. A pricing proposal for 15 users at $25,000 annually was presented, with potential discounts for larger teams. Concerns regarding competitor solutions, particularly around integration complexities with LaunchDarkly, were raised, alongside the feasibility of open-source alternatives. The team expressed a desire to make a decision quickly, with a budget target of $20,000 and a focus on the Enterprise plan's reliability improvements. Upcoming meetings were scheduled to further explore the integration of GrowthBook’s features and experimentation capabilities.
calls.keywords: Enterprise SLA, Feature Flags, Experimentation, Pricing Proposal, Integration, Reliability Issues
calls.action_items:
